initial.reason: R1: Verify before block on weak signal (prob < 0.70, single signal).
Fraud probability >= 0.30 requires creating a case.

R1: Customer confirmed they did not make the online purchase; transaction 3450629 must be declined.

sar.reason: Exposure is $100.09 (well below the $1,000 threshold), no fraud ring or coordinated/undocumented pattern is present, and fraud is not strongly suspected beyond a standard single-card unauthorized CNP event.

stop_reason: Investigation completed following customer verification confirming unauthorized card-not-present activity, resulting in transaction declination and card blocking per Policy Section 6.
